1235098866.name: Powder Keg
1235098866.desc: Throw a barrel that explodes after a delay, dealing spirit damage , setting enemies on fire and applying knockup . The barrel can be detonated early by being shot , melee'd , or detonated by another barrel. The burn stacks, so overlapping barrels burn for their combined damage. Can be Alt-Cast to place the barrel infront of Holliday.

2240607294.name: Bounce Pad
2240607294.desc: Drop a bounce pad in the world that launches any hero . You explode on landing, dealing Damage to any nearby enemies. The explosion can only occur once per person per Bounce Pad.

3190606822.name: Spirit Lasso
3190606822.desc: Throw out your lasso, dealing spirit damage , pulling , and applying stun . Using a Bounce Pad extends the duration of Spirit Lasso.

4179229681.name: Crackshot
4179229681.desc: Headshots deal bonus Damage and applies a Fading Move Speed penalty . This effect can only occur when off cooldown. Cooldown is reduced by 50% on NPC hits. Crackshot ignores range damage fall-off and does not apply to objectives.

2824119765.name: Shoulder Charge
2824119765.desc: Charge forward, pulling enemies you hit. Pushing a hero into a wall applies stun . If you collide with a hero you move faster during your charge.

715762406.name: Infernal Resilience
715762406.desc: Gain bonus defensive attributes. Taking damage grants temporary regeneration for a portion of the damage taken.

509856396.name: Seismic Impact
509856396.desc: Leap high into the air before crashing into the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying stun .

4072270083.name: Siphon Life
4072270083.desc: Drain health from nearby enemies, dealing spirit damage over time and healing for a portion of the damage dealt.

3089858203.name: Exploding Uppercut
3089858203.desc: Deal melee damage to nearby enemies and apply knockback . When they land, they deal spirit damage and apply reduced fire rate to other nearby enemies. Exploding Uppercut can be used on allies.

2521902222.name: Sticky Bomb
2521902222.desc: Attach a bomb that explodes after a delay, dealing spirit damage to nearby enemies. If the bomb hits or kills a hero, you gain permanent bonus damage on Sticky Bomb. Stacks diminish by half after 60 hits and 7 kills

3832675871.name: Hyper Beam
3832675871.desc: Channel a powerful torrent of energy that deals spirit damage and applies slow .

1928108461.name: Grapple Arm
1928108461.desc: Launch out a mechanical hand that pulls the first character it hits, reeling them in. Grapple Arm can be used on allies.

58655583.name: Pulse Grenade
58655583.desc: Throw a grenade that begins pulsing when it lands. Each pulse expands the radius and applies spirit damage , time slow, and stacking increased damage for Paradox against the victim.

1366719170.name: Time Wall
1366719170.desc: Create a time warping wall that stops time for all enemy projectiles and bullets that touch it and increases the speed and damage of friendly bullets. Enemies that touch the wall will be briefly slowed and silenced .

1128670012.name: Kinetic Carbine
1128670012.desc: Charge up a powerful shot of time energy, dealing spirit damage and applying a Time-Stop to enemies hit. The damage dealt increases with weapon damage . Move speed is increased while charging. While in the air and charging, to timeslow your movement.

2917891787.name: Paradoxical Swap
2917891787.desc: Fire a projectile that swaps your position with the target enemy hero.

3760705623.name: Kinetic Pulse
3760705623.desc: Release an energy pulse that travels along the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying knockup .

2031714424.name: Quantum Entanglement
2031714424.desc: Briefly become untargetable while teleporting to the target location. Restores stamina upon use. : Bring nearby allies with you.

492030745.name: Rejuvenating Aurora
492030745.desc: While channeling, restore health over time to you and any allies nearby. You can dash and melee without breaking the channel.

249410288.name: Singularity
249410288.desc: Create a singularity in your hands, dealing spirit damage over time , applying stun , and pulling in nearby enemies.

2142734020.name: Medicinal Specter
2142734020.desc: Deploy a spirit that provides healing to nearby allies.

3133377790.name: Mini Turret
3133377790.desc: Deploy a turret that shoots enemies, dealing spirit damage over time . The turret expires after a limited lifetime. Turrets deal reduced damage to troopers and objectives.

1725685134.name: Spectral Wall
1725685134.desc: Cast a wall that applies slow on enemies it passes through. Erupt the wall to divide the terrain in half and damage nearby enemies. After casting, press or Ability 3 to erupt the wall early. Can be Destroyed with Melee Attacks

3503044146.name: Heavy Barrage
3503044146.desc: Unleashes a volley of rockets that home in on a targeted location. McGinnis is slowed and is still able to use stamina.

715325746.name: Essence Bomb
715325746.desc: Sacrifice some of your health to launch a bomb that deals damage after a brief arm time. Self damage type is Spirit and can be mitigated.

3230530872.name: Malice
3230530872.desc: Sacrifice some of your health to launch blood shards that apply a stack of Malice. Each stack slows the victim and increases the damage they take from you. The slow effect decreases over time.

218284420.name: Life Drain
218284420.desc: Create a tether that drains enemy health over time and heals you . Target must be in line of sight and within max range to drain. You can shoot and use other abilities during the drain, but your move speed is reduced. to give health to friendly Heroes .

1307289689.name: Soul Exchange
1307289689.desc: Swaps health levels with an enemy target. There is a minimum health percentage that enemies can be brought down to and a minimum amount of health received based on victims current health.

1065103387.name: Lightning Ball
1065103387.desc: Shoot a ball of lightning that travels in a straight line. Does damage to all targets in its radius . Slows down when damaging enemies and stops if it hits the world.

1074714947.name: Static Charge
1074714947.desc: Apply a charge to a target enemy hero. After a short duration, the static charge stuns and damages enemies within the radius.

539192269.name: Power Surge
539192269.desc: Power up your weapon with a shock effect, making your bullets proc shock damage on your target . This shock damage bounces to enemies near your target. Occurs once per burst shot.

2061574352.name: Storm Cloud
2061574352.desc: Channel an expanding storm cloud around you that damages all enemies within its radius. Enemies do not take damage when they are out of line-of-sight.

2948410412.name: Sleep Dagger
2948410412.desc: Throw a dagger that damages and sleeps the target. Sleeping targets wake up shortly after being damaged. Throwing a Dagger does not break your invisibility. Sleep Dagger does not interrupt enemies' channeling abilities.

2414191464.name: Smoke Bomb
2414191464.desc: Fade out of sight, becoming invisible and gaining sprint speed . Attacking removes invisibility, but using items does not. Close enemies can see through your invisibility.

1080948381.name: Fixation
1080948381.desc: Shooting a target increases your bullet damage on that target . Gain one stack per bullet hit, two if the hit is a headshot.

731943444.name: Bullet Dance
731943444.desc: Enter a flurry, firing your weapon at nearby enemies with perfect accuracy and added Bullet Damage.

537527508.name: Stake
537527508.desc: Throw a stake that tethers enemies to the location where the stake lands. Enemy movement is restricted to the length of the tether.

1796564033.name: Flight
1796564033.desc: Leap into the air and fly . While in flight your weapon deals bonus spirit damage and your items have increased range.

2048438176.name: Crow Familiar
2048438176.desc: Your crow familiar deals impact damage , reduces their bullet resist and applies a bleed that deals damage based on the target's current health .

775377419.name: Assassinate
775377419.desc: Use your scoped rifle to fire a powerful shot over long distances. Deal only partial damage until fully charged after 1.0s of being scoped. Does bonus damage to enemies with less than 50% health remaining. Landing a killing blow on a player with Assassinate grants you bonus weapon damage .

1142270357.name: Concussive Combustion
1142270357.desc: Become a living bomb, dealing spirit damage and applying stun to all nearby enemies after a delay. Once cast, Concussive Combustion cannot be interrupted.

3516947824.name: Flame Dash
3516947824.desc: Dash forward, gaining slow resistance while leaving a flaming trail that deals spirit damage over time . Hold [W] while active to dash farther.

491391007.name: Napalm
491391007.desc: Spew an incendiary mixture, dealing spirit damage , applying slow , and coating targets in napalm .

1593133799.name: Afterburn
1593133799.desc: Weapon hits build up a burning effect, dealing spirit damage over time . Abilities refresh to the base burn duration and weapon hits extend it.

2351041382.name: Arctic Beam
2351041382.desc: Shoot freezing cold energy out in front of you, damaging targets and progressively reducing their movement and fire rate the longer you sustain the beam on them. You have reduced move speed while using Arctic Beam. The beam may also claim Souls.

1963397252.name: Ice Path
1963397252.desc: Kelvin creates a floating trail of ice and snow that gives movement bonuses to him and his allies. Kelvin gains 60% slow resistance for the duration. Enemies can also walk on the floating trail. Press Dash / Crouch / slide to travel up or down while in Ice Path.

18921423.name: Frost Grenade
18921423.desc: Throw a grenade that explodes in a cloud of freezing ice that heals allies and applies spirit damage and move speed reduction to enemies.

3826390464.name: Frozen Shelter
3826390464.desc: Target yourself or a Hero to freeze the air and create an impenetrable dome around them. While in the dome, allies gain rapid regeneration and enemies are slowed . Objectives becomes Invulnerable and Frozen under Frozen Shelter

2670099061.name: Grapple
2670099061.desc: Pull yourself through the air toward a target. Using Grapple also resets your limit of air jumps and dashes .

3561817145.name: Ground Strike
3561817145.desc: Stomp the ground beneath you, damaging enemies in front of you. If you perform Ground Strike while airborne, you quickly dive towards the ground. Damage grows slower after 25m.

397010810.name: Death Slam
397010810.desc: Focus on enemies to connect whips to them. After channeling, connected enemies are lifted and stunned then slammed into the ground. Your victims and any enemies in the landing zone will be damaged and slowed . Press to throw connected enemies early. Enemies that are not in line of sight or go out of range during the latch time will not be grabbed.

519124136.name: Flog
519124136.desc: Strike enemies in front of you with your whip, healing for a portion of the damage dealt.

1336069669.name: Dust Devil
1336069669.desc: Transform yourself into a whirlwind that travels forward, damaging enemies , slowing their move speed and lifting them up in the air. After emerging from the tornado you gain bullet evasion .

2221949202.name: Djinn's Mark
2221949202.desc: Active: Consume all Djinn Mark's to deal its damage now.

3733594387.name: Fire Scarabs
3733594387.desc: Infest an enemy with fire scarabs, stealing life from them and causing them to deal reduced damage.

2604653402.name: Traveler
2604653402.desc: Target a location on the minimap. After a brief wait, teleport to that location. Taking damage during the wait period causes the teleport to be interrupted.

1454278799.name: Scorn
1454278799.desc: Deal damage to nearby enemies and heal yourself based on the damage done. Heal is stronger against enemy heroes.

2406758797.name: Burrow
2406758797.desc: Burrow underground, moving faster, and gaining spirit and bullet armor . Damage from enemy heroes will reduce the speed bonus. When you jump out, deal spirit damage , slow , and knockup .

1914797280.name: Sand Blast
1914797280.desc: Spray sand that disarms enemies in front of you and deals damage .

1917840730.name: Combo
1917840730.desc: Hold the target in place, stunning them and dealing damage during the channel. If they die during, or within 3 seconds of Combo ending, you permanently gain max health.

1009029159.name: Ava
1009029159.desc: Turn to shadows and possess Ava. You gain bonus move speed that increases over time, and become hidden on the minimap . Taking damage from an enemy hero resets your bonus move speed and puts Ava on a brief cooldown.

4131517918.name: Gloom Bombs
4131517918.desc: Throw a cluster of bombs that detonate after a delay, dealing spirit damage . Enemies hit by multiple bombs take 65% damage.

2054144742.name: Return to Shadows
2054144742.desc: Instantly turn to shadows, becoming untargetable , gaining bonus move speed , and dealing spirit damage . After a delay, return from the shadows, dealing spirit damage again.

1426567660.name: Leaping Slash
1426567660.desc: Dash forward before slashing all enemies in a circle, dealing melee damage . If the ability hits at least one hero, heal a small amount of health.

548943648.name: Charged Shot
548943648.desc: Charge up a powerful shot that pierces through enemies. Hold Ability 1 or to hold the shot.

3452399392.name: Rain of Arrows
3452399392.desc: Launches you high in the air, allowing you to glide slowly. While airborne, you gain Weapon Damage and multishot on your weapon . for reduced jump height. Press Jump / mantle to cancel the glide.

512733154.name: Spirit Snare
512733154.desc: Throw out a trap that begins to arm itself. Once armed, the trap will trigger when an enemy enters its radius, applying Curse and Movement Slow that interrupts, Silences, Disarms , and prevents item usage . Hit the trap with a Charged Shot to detonate early with increased radius.

3242902780.name: Guided Owl
3242902780.desc: After 1.5s cast time, launch a spirit owl that you control and which explodes on impact, damaging and stunning enemies. Hold [W] to accelerate the owl. Press Jump / mantle to release control. Gain permanent Spirit Power for each enemy hero killed with Guided Owl.

2460791803.name: Serrated Knives
2460791803.desc: Throw a knife that bleeds an enemy. Each additional hit adds a stack and refreshes the bleed duration, causing the bleed to increase per stack.

1458044103.name: Slice and Dice
1458044103.desc: Perform a dash forward, damaging enemies along the path . Hit Enemies have their spirit resist reduced. This debuff can stack.

1537272748.name: Bloodletting
1537272748.desc: Take only a portion of incoming damage immediately and defer the rest to be taken over time. Activate to clear a portion of the deferred damage .

1976701714.name: Flying Cloak
1976701714.desc: Launch a sentient cloak that travels forward and damages enemies . You can press Ability 2 to teleport to its location.

3747867012.name: Enchanter's Satchel
3747867012.desc: Escape into your suitcase. When the duration ends, deal spirit damage to nearby enemies. Duration can be ended early by performing any action.

938149308.name: Barrage
938149308.desc: Channel to start launching projectiles that deal spirit damage and apply slow around their impact point. Projectiles that hit a hero grant Pocket increased damage that stacks . Casting while airborne will cause Pocket to float . Casting AirDash or Flying Cloaking will not cancel Barrage.

2954330093.name: Affliction
2954330093.desc: Applies damage over time to enemies nearby. Affliction's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.

1531378655.name: Kudzu Connection
1531378655.desc: Connect with a nearby ally to gain bonuses, replicated healing, and ignore the move speed penalty while shooting. Receive 50% of Bonuses with no connection Connection requires line of sight.

4111222521.name: Entangling Thorns
4111222521.desc: Summon a patch of choking thorns that damage and slows enemies in its radius.

3642273386.name: Stone Form
3642273386.desc: Turn yourself into impervious stone and smash into the ground, stunning and damaging enemies nearby. Heals you for a percentage of your max health.

1247583368.name: Air Drop
1247583368.desc: Grab an ally and take flight with them. Drop your ally to cause an explosion, dealing spirit damage . You and your ally gain increased Outgoing Damage when flying ends. Cooldown reduced by 30% when used on allies. Taking damage briefly disables using the ability. While lifted, your ally cannot attack and deals -20% damage.

3247040238.name: Splatter
3247040238.desc: Throw a ball of goo that deals damage and leaves puddles of goo behind that apply movement slow to enemies in the radius.

3788152387.name: The Cube
3788152387.desc: Encase the target in a cube of restorative goo that protects from damage, and increases health regen . Target is unable to take any new actions while cubed. Can be used on self. Press Jump / mantle to escape early.

4206531918.name: Goo Ball
4206531918.desc: Morph into a large goo ball that deals damage and stuns enemies on impact. The ball grants large amounts of Bullet and Spirit resist, bounces off walls and can double jump .

1020817390.name: Puddle Punch
1020817390.desc: Materialize a fist in the world that punches everyone in the area, applying knockup . Punching an enemy deals melee damage and applies slow . You and your allies have increased Air Control.

1656913918.name: Binding Word
1656913918.desc: Curse an enemy hero. If they don't move away from their initial position within the escape time , they will be damaged and immobilized .

2751689917.name: Willpower
2751689917.desc: Gain a Barrier and bonus move speed .

2656490109.name: Alchemical Flask
2656490109.desc: Throw a flask that damages and reduces the weapon damage and move speed of enemies it hits.

2702908623.name: Last Stand
2702908623.desc: After charging for 2s, release pulses that damage enemies and heal you based on the damage done. While channeling Last Stand you have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist .

2981692841.name: Telekinesis
2981692841.desc: Lift an enemy hero into the air and then slam them towards the target location .

1842576017.name: Full Auto
1842576017.desc: Temporarily boosts your fire rate and deal bonus spirit damage

1999680326.name: Card Trick
1999680326.desc: Deal weapon damage to summon cards of a random suit. Each card can be thrown, dealing damage and applying a different effect depending of its suit. Cards thrown fly towards the enemy or point under your crosshair. Alt-cast to throw first card

208809857.name: Consume
208809857.desc: Latches onto an Enemy, damaging them and healing yourself while attached. Targets must be in line of sight and within max range to stay latched. A successful kill also restores a Bio Blast charge.

3422822440.name: Bio Blast
3422822440.desc: Shoots out a blast of consumed remains, damaging and slowing enemies. Multiple hits increase the slow.

3426178920.name: Overload
3426178920.desc: Create an area that slows nearby enemies and damages them after a channel. Damage scales with total channel time.

2153275594.name: Wrecking Ball
2153275594.desc: Create a large ball of scrap, damaging and stunning the first enemy hit. Nearby enemies take reduced damage.

3255651252.name: Power Slash
3255651252.desc: Channel to increase damage over 1.4 seconds, then release a fully-charged sword strike . Press Ability 1 or to trigger the strike early, dealing partial damage.

2566573207.name: Flying Slash
2566573207.desc: Throw a grappling hook to reel yourself towards an enemy, dealing Light melee damage and slowing the target when you arrive.

2366960452.name: Crimson Slash
2366960452.desc: Slash enemies in front of you, damaging them and slowing their fire rate . If any enemy heroes are hit, you heal .

3319782965.name: Shadow Transformation
3319782965.desc: Become infused with Yamato's shadow soul. After an initial invincible transformation your abilities are refreshed and are 60% faster . You gain immunity to negative status effects and have greatly increased bullet and spirit resist . When you get a hero kill, you heal and the duration is extended.

1469918191.name: Slither
1469918191.desc: You have increased Slide Distance, can Slide up hills, and can turn faster while Sliding.

3428732129.name: Lethal Venom
3428732129.desc: Inject a target with lethal venom. After a delay the venom triggers, dealing Spirit Damage . The damage is increased by the target's missing health. Lethal Venom will ignore Petrify's damage block.

645773760.name: Screwjab Dagger
645773760.desc: Throw a dagger, dealing spirit damage and applying slow . Every subsequent dagger against the same target stacks in spirit damage and slow .

1594727071.name: Petrifying Bola
1594727071.desc: Throw an explosive bola. On exploding, the bola Slows and Damages all enemies in the area. Direct hits deal Additional Damage and Petrify instead. Petrified units block all damage, but cannot take actions.

3156905386.name: Vexing Bolt
3156905386.desc: Fire a bolt of magic that deals Damage , increasing as it travels . If you have an Assistant , they also cast Vexing Bolt at reduced damage. Press Ability 1 to redirect the bolt towards your crosshairs.

12456023.name: Spectral Assistant
12456023.desc: Summon an Assistant at the targeted location. The Assistant attacks whenever you fire your weapon, dealing Damage . While the Assistant is out, you can press Ability 2 to swap positions with your Assistant . Casting Spectral Assistant also reloads your weapon.

191022746.name: Audience Participation
191022746.desc: Copy the Ultimate of an enemy hero for a limited time. Reactivating the ability will use the Copied Ultimate instead. Copies will inherit this ability's upgrade points. Audience Participation will also copy the cooldown.

2142213586.name: Rabbit Hex
2142213586.desc: Hex a target area and transforming all enemies into a Rabbit for a limited duration. Rabbits are small and move faster , but take increased Damage and are unable to perform most actions . Hex does not interrupt abilities.

2675680636.name: Bottled Phantasmicide
2675680636.desc: Throw a jar that leaves a spreading toxic pool . Enemies caught in the pool are Slowed and Silenced .

2876116869.name: Crawling Plague
2876116869.desc: Release a wave of spectral spiders that chase enemies and explode, dealing Spirit Damage . Hit enemies are poisoned , temporarily losing Spirit and Spirit Resist . This effect can stack multiple times.

3322902852.name: Pest Barrier
3322902852.desc: Apply a Combat Barrier to a target ally and periodically deal Spirit Damage and Slows .

3360792911.name: Silktrap
3360792911.desc: Create a thread of web between two surfaces. Enemies who touch the web take Damage over time , become Slowed and are Revealed .

4210991587.name: Umbrella Maneuver
4210991587.desc: Use your umbrella to catch a gust of wind that lifts you backwards. You then charge up your umbrella to fire a projectile that explodes on impact.

1101238302.name: Revelation
1101238302.desc: Activate your relic. Enemy heroes nearby have slowed movement and dashes, and receive damage over time when looking towards you . If enemies look at you long enough, they get cursed .

3248109871.name: Demontrigger Blitz
3248109871.desc: Load your weapon with demonic rounds . After a delay, release a blitz of bullets at the target enemy, dealing bonus Damage . Enemies can intercept the bullets.

2839987102.name: Infernal Brand
2839987102.desc: Passively mark nearby enemies with a Brand . Shooting an enemy with a Brand consumes the effect, dealing bonus Damage and granting Fire Rate and Movement Speed .

2398133749.name: Sanguine Retreat
2398133749.desc: Briefly disperse, becoming untargetable and flying to a target location. Can be recast within a brief window.

1233782561.name: Love Bites
1233782561.desc: Your bullets apply additional spirit damage . Dealing damage your abilities builds up to a vicious bite , dealing a burst of bonus spirit damage . Love Bites has a unique cooldown per target.

3379486147.name: Nox Nostra
3379486147.desc: Active: Unleash a cloud of bats that seek out targets, each dealing spirit damage and applying Silence . Passive: Triggering Love Bites against heroes permanently increases the number of bats released.

370209602.name: Intertwine
370209602.desc: Enemies hit by spirit damage are linked to other linked enemies, sharing a portion of incoming damage as bonus spirit damage .

2000761890.name: Skipshot
2000761890.desc: Throw a projectile that bounces between targets, dealing spirit damage . If there are no enemies nearby Skipshot will instead bounce off of Boho, reducing its cooldown .

3962304265.name: Swish
3962304265.desc: Swing twice, dealing spirit damage to targets in front. Hits against heroes grant bonus move speed and stacking barrier .

682591488.name: Jeté
682591488.desc: Leap in a target direction. If no direction is chosen, then leap straight up instead.

1418303954.name: Acrobat
1418303954.desc: Gain stacking bonuses every time you dash , double jump , wall jump , or teleport . Gaining new stacks refreshes the duration.

228680142.name: Flakshot
228680142.desc: Bullets deal bonus weapon damage and can ricochet off of surfaces.

201562678.name: Lifethread
201562678.desc: Fire a line that attaches to the world, allowing you to swing. Lifethread resets all air jumps and air dashes.

3727084744.name: Jumpstart
3727084744.desc: Deal spirit damage to yourself. Then, gain bonus regeneration and bonus move speed , decaying over time.

1472593493.name: Aura of Suffering
1472593493.desc: Unleash pain, dealing spirit damage over time to both enemies and yourself. The damage continues to increase the longer the ability is channeled, up to a maximum amount.

3493884851.name: Shocking Reanimation
3493884851.desc: Release a wave after taking lethal damage, applying a diminishing slow . After a brief channel you reanimate, dealing spirit damage and applying stun to nearby enemies.

2043074967.name: Pain Battery
2043074967.desc: Taking any damage passively charges up your Pain Battery. Once full, activating the ability fires multiple shocking bolts, dealing spirit damage once per target.

604448162.name: Bookwyrm
604448162.desc: Conjure a dragon that appears at the target location before flying forward, dealing spirit damage and leaving a burning path in its trail.

3054993162.name: Captivating Read
3054993162.desc: Target an area with latent magic, applying slow . The magic detonates after a delay, dealing spirit damage and applying immobilize .

3553292912.name: Plot Armor
3553292912.desc: Grant an ally a barrier . While the barrier holds, they gain bonus weapon damage .

1841901343.name: Rallying Charge
1841901343.desc: Release a wave of spectral knights and steeds that charge across the entire city , healing allies and dealing spirit damage to enemies. The strength of the heal and spirit damage is amplified as the knights travel further.

109766091.name: Doorway
109766091.desc: Place two connected doors in the world. Players and most projectiles entering one door will exit out through the other. The doors will close at the end of the duration. The two doors must be placed within the doorway distance of each other.

1719512318.name: Luggage Cart
1719512318.desc: Send out a luggage Cart that deals spirit damage and pulls enemy heroes along its path. Can be alt cast with to target friendly heroes instead.

103496908.name: Call Bell
103496908.desc: Throw out a call bell that deals spirit damage on impact. After a short delay it explodes, dealing additional spirit damage and causing affected enemies to suffer reduced weapon accuracy and movement slow . Can be shot to detonate early.

1703045691.name: Hotel Guest
1703045691.desc: Send the target's physical body to be a guest at the Baroness Hotel. The guest is to promptly make their way to the exit elevator, where they'll be sent back to their original position. A stay at the Baroness Hotel is paid for in spirit damage . Failure to check-out on time costs additional spirit damage .

3296031213.name: Blasted
3296031213.desc: Passive: Melee hits restore ammo and inflict wrecked on the victim for 7.0s.

3762861984.name: Chain Gang
3762861984.desc: Chain nearby enemies to you. Chained enemies cannot use movement abilities and receive a heavy slow when they pull on the chain. After a delay, yank everyone towards Billy and deal spirit damage . The chain breaks if you lose line of sight for a short while.

1792773251.name: Rising Ram
1792773251.desc: Charge head-first into an enemy and send them into the air along with Billy. Cooldown reduced by 50% on impact.

1841661392.name: Bashdown
1841661392.desc: Slam your bat into the ground, pulling enemies down and dealing melee damage . The slam creates a shockwave that deals spirit damage and applies knockup .

3120550633.name: Rend
3120550633.desc: Swipe at enemies in a cone ahead of you, dealing spirit damage . If the enemy is in close range , deal bonus melee damage .

1264175662.name: Stalker's Mark
1264175662.desc: Send out a mark that bleeds the first target it hits, dealing spirit damage over time . While the enemy is bleeding you can re-activate Stalker's Mark to instantly appear behind their back.

1168182161.name: Eternal Night
1168182161.desc: Surround nearby enemy heroes in darkness, severely limiting their vision of other units . Affected enemies are briefly revealed to you and are considered isolated for the duration. You gain bonus sprint speed .

1764146857.name: Gutshot
1764146857.desc: Fire a blast with your shotgun, dealing weapon damage and pushing enemies back. Enemies near a wall receive stun and take bonus weapon damage .

2918874166.name: Ira Domini
2918874166.desc: Load your crossbow with 3 stakes , dealing massively increased weapon damage . The final stake is blessed , dealing bonus pure damage and executing low-health enemies.

911307831.name: Consecrating Grenade
911307831.desc: Fire a grenade that bounces before exploding, dealing weapon damage and setting enemies on fire. Burning targets deal pure damage to enemies in the area and suffer from reduced healing .

11154161.name: Hex-Lined Snap Trap
11154161.desc: Kick a trap that arms after a brief delay. The trap springs on the first enemy it touches, dealing spirit damage , applying immobilize , and revealing enemies for a duration afterwards.

3692321247.name: Pillow Toss
3692321247.desc: Throw your trusty pillow inflicting spirit damage and heavy knockback . Landing hits reduces the cooldown of your other abilities.

2396527575.name: Naptime
2396527575.desc: Cast your gaze forward, piercing walls and floors. Enemies in the gaze are slowed, have reduced dash distance, and cannot use movement abilities. When the channel ends they fall asleep before waking up to a splitting headache that deals heavy spirit damage .

536278136.name: Lil Helpers
536278136.desc: Signal a Helper to lend a hand. They can collect boxes, do Sinner's Sacrifices, or be sent to support allies and troopers. Follow a hero: Provides a short burst of spirit resist and fading move speed . Follow a trooper: Provides healing, damage, resists, and allows tagging along. When no hero is around, souls from trooper kills are split amongst the team. Can be cast during Tag Along. Helpers will take a nap for 15.1s after following someone.

1568845221.name: Tag Along
1568845221.desc: Jump to an ally and nap alongside them. Both you and the ally receive a burst heal based on missing health followed by lingering regeneration . Hop between allies with Ability 2 to apply the heal, once per ally. You are knocked off if stunned by an ultimate ability. You can use items and all self-casts target your ally instead.

725153709.name: Disengaging Sigil
725153709.desc: Draw a sigil sphere in front of you and then leap backwards as it explodes, damaging and slowing enemies caught in it.

2006773718.name: Riposte
2006773718.desc: Prepare to deflect the next incoming attack. On a successful deflection, briefly become invulnerable and target an enemy hero to dash towards them, stunning them and reducing their Melee Resist . Press Ability 2 to select a target. Does not trigger against trooper or neutral damage.

147493976.name: Flawless Advance
147493976.desc: Perform a series of lunges in any direction, delivering piercing stabs ahead of you. Hold your ability key to time your attacks, dealing more damage the longer it's held. Releasing your attack during the perfect window deals maximum damage . Press Ability 3 to re-cast.

494112189.name: Itani Lo Sahn
494112189.desc: Charge up and perform a long range slash. Struck enemies cannot take action or heal and are stuck in slow motion. When this effect expires, they suffer devastating damage , dealing bonus damage against half-health enemies. While in slow motion, Apollo is invulnerable and enemies take reduced damage. Hold Ability 4 or to delay the cast.

2001589780.name: Grasping Hands
2001589780.desc: Unearth a line of grasping hands, summoning a Ghoul and leaving behind a rift. Enemies who pass through take spirit damage and receive immobilize . Alt-Cast rotates the orientation of the wall.

3214055642.name: Jar of Dead
3214055642.desc: Passive: Collect death when anything dies nearby and store it in your Jar of Dead. Active: Throw a jar to summon Deadheads that repeatedly deal spirit damage to enemies. Deadheads follow you instead if there's no nearby enemies, and prioritize the target of your weapon.

629925354.name: Essence Theft
629925354.desc: Your weapon steals weapon damage and spirit resist over time, up to a maximum amount per target.

1385849824.name: Slam Fire
1385849824.desc: Instantly reload your gun. You gain bonus fire rate and deal bonus weapon damage based on the target's health for a limited number of shots, but suffer from reduced accuracy. Deals bonus Weapon Damage against troopers and neutrals.

3983754897.name: Entangling Bola
3983754897.desc: Throw a bola, dealing spirit damage , applying slow and preventing movement abilities or stamina.

515791019.name: Lycan Curse
515791019.desc: Passive: Dealing damage generates bloodlust, increased at low health. At max bloodlust, you automatically cast Lycan Curse. Active: Instantly transform, gaining increased max health , and stacking fire rate on enemy heroes, and replacing your abilities and weapon with their ferocious versions.

3443575800.name: Light Eater
3443575800.desc: Blast enemies in a cone in front of you with a flare of light. Blasted enemies take spirit damage when attacked by Celeste and provides her spirit lifesteal .

1950738949.name: Dazzling Trick
1950738949.desc: Surround yourself in a protective prism. If the barrier is destroyed, it silences nearby enemies and deals a portion of the barrier as damage.

2590796390.name: Shining Wonder
2590796390.desc: Launch a deadly orb of light that deals spirit damage and applies slow and reduces Dash Distance on impact. The orb then bounces to the enemies within range. If no target is found, the orb will linger for a short duration while continuing to look for targets. Prioritizes enemy heroes when picking targets.

1011349580.name: Radiant Daggers
1011349580.desc: Call down a beam of light from the sky. After a short duration, the beam will fully form, causing an explosion that deals spirit damage to all targets in the area. Celeste will receive a stacking buff that increases her spirit damage anytime this hits an enemy hero.
